summary: Asia Pacific Wire & Cable Corporation Limited filed a Form 6-K attaching its November 12, 2026 press release reporting third-quarter 2026 financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026. Revenue was $161.7 million, up 18% sequentially and 26% year over year, with EPS of $0.03 versus $0.01 in Q2 and $0.05 a year earlier. Gross margin was 7.9%, down from 8.1% and 8.7%. Volume and copper-price effects plus public-sector contract timing drove the swings. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation, with no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. Watch operating margin and working capital.
